video_title: Perk Crowns Ant & LaMelo The NBA’s BEST Backcourt

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins criticizes Brad Stevens for his recent roster decisions
quotes.excerpt: Brad Stevens, you dropped the ball. This is the one time that he's fucked up
quotes.quote: Brad Stevens, you dropped the ball. This is the one time that he's fucked up and he got to make it right.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye warns Jalen Brunson to let his play do the talking
quotes.excerpt: Jalen got to shut up and let his hooping do the talking. Cause you bout to fuck the money up.
quotes.quote: Jalen got to shut up and let his hooping do the talking. Cause you bout to fuck the money up.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins calls Anthony Edwards and LaMelo Ball the best backcourt
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards and fucking LaMelo Ball? You tell me how you gone stop it. That is the best backcourt in the NBA.
quotes.quote: Anthony Edwards and fucking LaMelo Ball? You tell me how you gone stop it. That is the best backcourt in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins argues the Bucks cannot win a championship with Giannis as the primary option
quotes.excerpt: You will not win a championship if Giannis Antetokounmpo is your number one option.
quotes.quote: I repeat, you will not win a championship if Giannis Antetokounmpo is your number one option.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins claims franchise players are not valued as they once were
quotes.excerpt: Franchise players are not valued as franchise players like it used to be back in the day.
quotes.quote: I keep telling people, franchise players are not valued as franchise players like it used to be back in the day. If you're a franchise player and you're getting paid top dollar, your ass got to earn them dollars, otherwise you'll be on the first thing smoking.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins discusses the trade of LaMelo Ball to Minnesota
quotes.excerpt: LaMelo Ball, Charlotte Hornets. Think about it. That man just got traded to Minnesota.
quotes.quote: LaMelo Ball, Charlotte Hornets. Think about it. That man just got traded to Minnesota.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises LaMelo Ball as an All-NBA caliber point guard
quotes.excerpt: I think LaMelo Ball is a hell of a player. I think he's an All-NBA caliber point guard.
quotes.quote: I think LaMelo Ball is a hell of a player. I think he's an All-NBA caliber point guard. I believe that a lot of people give him unfair criticism because of his style of play, but make no mistake about it, he's no criminal. He's really a role model.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye expresses doubt about Jalen Brunson fitting into the current system
quotes.excerpt: I think he's incredible. Do I think he fits in that system? I don't think so.
quotes.quote: I think he's incredible. Do I think he fits in that system? I don't think so.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye criticizes the decision to trade Naz Reid
quotes.excerpt: I don't think they should have got rid of Naz Reid, me personally.
quotes.quote: I don't think they should have got rid of Naz Reid, me personally. I like Naz Reid. I like the fact, I like what he did for the team and how he fit in with him and it's the chemistry between him and McDaniels was always there, but where the big man?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins explains the necessity of the Timberwolves' recent trade
quotes.excerpt: Minnesota had to make that trade. They were on the clock when it comes down to pleasing Anthony Edwards.
quotes.quote: Minnesota had to make that trade. They were on the clock when it comes down to pleasing Anthony Edwards. And when I say pleasing him, Andrew Wiggins, former number one overall pick for the Minnesota Timberwolves, he left, went on to a new team, won a championship. Kevin Garnett, same scenario. You have Karl-Anthony Towns. By the way, that trade arguably one of the worst trades in NBA history.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins calls the LaMelo Ball and Anthony Edwards backcourt the best in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: You bring back LaMelo with Anthony Edwards, that's the best backcourt in the NBA.
quotes.quote: And now, all of a sudden, you bring back LaMelo with Anthony Edwards, that's the best backcourt in the NBA. I repeat, that is the best fucking backcourt in the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins highlights the importance of Anthony Edwards' usage rate
quotes.excerpt: The one thing that we have to watch when Anthony Edwards is, over the last two years, his usage rate.
quotes.quote: The one thing that we have to watch when Anthony Edwards is, over the last two years, his usage rate. When it came down to him being ball dominant, having to be able to create and score buckets but being able to create for others and make guys around him better, that takes a toll on you.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins discusses Jalen McDaniels' development and contract
quotes.excerpt: Jalen McDaniels 6'9, 6'10, long lengthy, he gets better every single year.
quotes.quote: Jalen McDaniels 6'9, 6'10, long lengthy, he gets better every single year. They just gave Ayo Dosunmu, they just gave him 112 million. See, I'm looking at it and they saying, we're going to go small. We're going to spread this fucking court.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins expresses high expectations for Rudy Gobert
quotes.excerpt: Rudy, here you go. We gave up all these picks for you when we traded for you, four-time defensive player of the year.
quotes.quote: Rudy, here you go. We gave up all these picks for you when we traded for you, four-time defensive player of the year. We expect more out of you. So you spread the court, you go four out with Rudy, you talk about a high-power offense.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins discusses Kevin Garnett's new role with the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Garnett and the Minnesota Timberwolves just signed somewhat of a partnership deal.
quotes.quote: Kevin Garnett and the Minnesota Timberwolves just signed somewhat of a partnership deal. Kevin Garnett is basically the ambassador for the franchise, which should have happened way long time ago. So Kevin Garnett is going to be a mentor in that locker room to Anthony Edwards and LaMelo Ball.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins predicts Deandre Ayton's future in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: You might be out the league in a few years. And I'm going to tell you why.
quotes.quote: You might be out the league in a few years. And I'm going to tell you why. And I say this from the bottom of my damn soul, is that you were drafted with the number one pick to the Phoenix Suns. Y'all made an NBA Finals run.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins criticizes the Phoenix Suns for trading Deandre Ayton
quotes.excerpt: Portland opened the door. They did a whole big thing, oh we got Deandre Ayton.
quotes.quote: Portland opened the door. They did a whole big thing, oh we got Deandre Ayton. Man, it didn't take long. They was like, man, get your ass up out of here. They they did great last year without you.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins discusses LaMelo Ball's recruitment of players to LA
quotes.excerpt: All of a sudden, LaMelo lobby for you to come to LA.
quotes.quote: All of a sudden, LaMelo lobby for you to come to LA. Oh man, they got Deandre Ayton, man, that's a that's a that's a steel team-friendly contract. Let's bring him in.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins warns LaMelo Ball about his public comments
quotes.excerpt: Deandre, listen to me brother. I'm telling you something, real talk. Hey man, stop playing.
quotes.quote: Deandre, listen to me brother. I'm telling you something, real talk. Hey man, stop playing. Stop playing. It's not going to be too many more opportunities. They got these next three to four draft classes that's coming up. They got nothing but franchise players in there.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins warns LaMelo Ball about the consequences of his actions
quotes.excerpt: If your ass don't show up and show out, you're going to be out of the NBA.
quotes.quote: If your ass don't show up and show out, you're going to be out of the NBA. And that being said, with you, I'm with you, Perk. I don't see it.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins advises young athletes to choose partners wisely
quotes.excerpt: y'all got to choose wisely, man, and start doing a real investigation

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Athletes, or the younger athletes, y'all got to choose wisely, man, and start doing a real investigation before y'all start saying and start, you know, anointing these certain women as my gal or my wife. Because I've been with my woman, my wife, since the 10th grade, bro. We've been through our ups, downs, good, bad, ugly, whatever you want to call it.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: It never got physical, and she's my rider. There are times she's slapped the shit out of me because I didn't deserve to get the shit, you know what I'm saying? I didn't deserve it, you know what I'm saying? But I didn't push it like, damn, I made my old lady that motherfucking mad.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye warns young players about chasing women over money
quotes.excerpt: you lose a bunch of hoes chasing money. You're going to lose a bunch of money chasing hoes.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: I'm going to tell you one thing to the youngsters. Being in this business, being in hip hop, I'm going to tell you what I learned a long time ago. You lose a bunch of hoes chasing money. You're going to lose a bunch of money chasing hoes. If your thing is you're so stuck on them hoes, there ain't no way you're going to get the bag.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: You lose a bunch of money chasing hoes, but you don't lose no hoes chasing money. I'm going to tell you that right off the bat. That means you got to put all your everything into your career 1,000%. That need to be the focus.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing Frye on the importance of focusing on career before relationships
quotes.excerpt: get yourself in a position in your career when you can invest in somebody else

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Get yourself in a position in your career when you can invest in somebody else other than you. You are the whole brand right now. Once you do anything outside that prevents you from being the brand, you tarnish the brand. You got to go out there and get yourself in a winning position, and only when you get comfortable in that position, then if you want to bring somebody for a long the ride, then you do that.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins on maintaining his identity in any room
quotes.excerpt: when I walk up in the room, I feel like I'm that man.
quotes.quote: I don't give a damn what room I walk in and who's in that room. I don't care if it's Jay-Z, I don't care if it's President Trump, I don't care if it's President Obama, I don't give a damn if Beyonce, Rihanna, Tiger Woods, Michael Jordan. When I walk up in the room, I feel like I'm that man. I'm going to show respect, but when I walk up in the room, damn it, I feel like I'm that man.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins addresses the reality of domestic violence in relationships
quotes.excerpt: some guys that are having these domestic violent situations, they actually really do need help.
quotes.quote: Some guys that are having these domestic violent situations, they actually really do need help. They need love. And when I say that is because I'm not making no excuse for a man to put his hands on no woman whatsoever. But what I'm telling y'all is a lot of this is trauma. A lot of this is because they was raised in a household where they've seen and been taught that this is okay.
